core.long_description: Transport transforms, the discard endpoint, the bounded queue module, and device-format decoders. This package has no optional vendor SDK dependency.

dev.description: development headers for PipeWireAO SPA plugins
dev.long_description: Public factory names, property keys, schemas, and small header-only helpers for applications that configure the plugins.

fits.long_description: A fixed-cadence FITS vector and image-sequence source, including the simulated camera row-readout profile.

aravis.long_description: The experimental Aravis GenTL and native GigE Vision comparison source.

imagestreamio.long_description: SPA source and sink factories that copy ndarray buffers to and from milk ImageStreamIO shared-memory streams.

alpao.long_description: The ALPAO command-normalization FGN operator and deformable-mirror SPA sink linked to the separately provisioned proprietary ASDK runtime.

egrabber.long_description: The Euresys eGrabber camera manager, device, and source factories linked to the separately provisioned proprietary SDK runtime.

bgapi2.long_description: The Baumer GAPI2 camera source linked to the separately provisioned proprietary SDK runtime.

edtpdv.long_description: The EDT PCI DV/PDV Camera Link source linked to the separately provisioned proprietary SDK runtime.

flisdk.description: First Light Imaging source for PipeWireAO
flisdk.long_description: The First Light Imaging camera source linked to the separately provisioned proprietary FliSdk runtime.

andor3.long_description: The Andor camera source linked to the separately provisioned proprietary SDK3 runtime.

hamamatsu.long_description: The Hamamatsu camera source linked to the separately provisioned proprietary DCAM-API runtime.

hermes.long_description: The MPD HERMES FrontPanel camera source linked to the separately provisioned proprietary HERMES and Opal Kelly runtimes.
